noAccess.title: You cannot open Cutting
noAccess.body: This needs the permission {permission}. Ask an administrator to give it to your role.

tile.todayHint: Today, every table of your sites
tile.areaHint: Hides cut today and their area in square metres
tile.yieldHint: Pattern area over the area cut, against the BOM’s plan

list.search: Search work order, batch or style
list.failed: The cuts could not be read

noMatch.title: No rows match these filters
noMatch.body: Clear the filters to see every open cut.

empty.title: No cut orders yet
empty.body: A released work order with leather parts appears here. Start with New cut order.

list.hint: One cut is one work order’s leather, cut hide by hide at the cutting table. Fabric lays, markers and cut orders of several work orders come later (W2b).

held.reason: Say why in at least 3 characters.

tickets.one: Select one cut to open its tickets.

recut.done: This recut is not open any more.
recut.noEntry: No cut log entry has pieces of {part} for {cell} yet: the cutting table cuts it first.

ticket.scanned_one: Scanned once already: a bundle is voided only before its first scan.
ticket.scanned_other: Scanned {count} times already: a bundle is voided only before its first scan.

newCut.title: New cut order
newCut.body: Pick the work order to cut. Each released work order is one cut of one leather and colour; its hides are allocated next.
newCut.count_one: {count} work order waiting, no hide allocated
newCut.count_other: {count} work orders waiting, no hide allocated
newCut.table: The table is the cutting tablet’s station: every cut records the table it was cut at.
newCut.fabric: Fabric cut orders that group several work orders by lay come later (W2b).

empty.title: Nothing waits to be cut
empty.body: Every released work order with leather parts has hides allocated or is being cut.

why.material: Another leather: this cut order cuts {material}.

held.many: One work order per cut today: cut orders of several work orders come with fabric lays (W2b).

alloc.title: Allocate hides · {number}
alloc.body: {garments} garments, {pieces} pieces still to cut. Each hide picked is reserved whole for this work order; the cutting table’s first cut of it issues it.

why.other: Reserved for another work order or order
why.empty: Nothing left of it in stock

held.none: Pick at least one free hide.
held.cut: Every garment of this cut is cut.

alloc.heldWorkOrder: This work order is on hold ({reason}). Hides may be allocated; the cutting table cuts nothing for it until quality releases the hold.
alloc.failed: The hides could not be read

empty.title: No hide of this leather here
empty.body: No hide of this leather and colour is in stock at the work order’s site.

alloc.hint: A hide on hold or of a lot that is not released cannot be allocated, and the table refuses to cut it in the same words.

notice.reprinted: The ticket was printed again with a new code; the old code scans as replaced.
notice.voided: The bundle is void: its ticket no longer scans.

problem.offline: The factory server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
problem.write: This was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile. It was read again: check and try again.
problem.invalid: The request was refused as it is. Check the fields.

alloc.hide: A hide picked cannot be reserved any more (taken, on hold or used). Read the hides again.
alloc.reserved: A hide picked was reserved meanwhile for another work order or order. The hides were read again: pick another.
alloc.notInStock: A hide picked is no longer in stock at this site. The hides were read again.
alloc.lotHeld: A hide picked is of a lot that is not released: quality releases it first.

recut.notOfCell: That cut log entry has no pieces of this size and part.
recut.state: This recut is not open any more.

forbidden.title: You cannot open this cut
forbidden.body: Its work order belongs to a company or site you may not see.

missing.title: This cut does not exist
missing.body: Its work order was not found. It may belong to another company.

error.title: The cut could not be read

held.title: On hold: the cutting table cuts nothing for this work order
held.body: Why: {reason}. A cut of it, of a held hide or of a hide of a held lot is refused at the table in these words until quality releases the hold.

empty.title: No hide cut yet
empty.body: The hides the cutting table cuts for this work order appear here, with their area.

lay.noBalance: Nothing was issued to this work order yet.
lay.noAllocated: No hide is allocated and waiting.
lay.allocatedHint: Allocated hides are reserved whole for this work order; the same-shade check of a lay comes later (W2b).
lay.laysLater: Markers, plies, rolls by shade and width come with fabric cutting (W2b). Leather is cut hide by hide.

pieces.title: Pieces by part and size
pieces.none: No part of this work order is cut from hides.
pieces.hint: Cut / planned per part and size; planned is one piece of each part per garment (the BOM has no piece count per part yet).

recuts.title: Recuts
recuts.none: No recut is asked for this work order.
recuts.hint: Scrap & rework asks a recut for scrapped pieces; the cutting table cuts it as single parts, then the office links the entry that cut it.

dialog.title: Mark the recut as cut
dialog.entryHint: A cut of this size with pieces of this part.

held.entry: Pick the entry that cut it.

yield.title: Yield per hide
yield.unmatched: {area} cut as single parts is left out of the yield: their pattern is not known.
yield.none: Nothing was cut for this work order yet.
yield.hint: Per hide, lot and supplier; never by cutter. The reconciliation of issued, used and returned comes later (W2b).

tickets.title: Bundle tickets

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.body: Bundles are made at the cutting table after the cut; their tickets appear here.

tickets.hint: A ticket printed again gets a new code and the old one scans as replaced; the reason is kept.
tickets.reprintBody: The bundle gets a new code; the old ticket will scan as replaced.
tickets.noPrinter: No label printer at this site
tickets.voidBody: {garments} garments of {cell} go back to “cut, not bundled”; the ticket {code} no longer scans.
